commands.assertions: An uncooperative provider reaches an explicit deadline and bounded busy state without preventing catalog calls.
27 Portal UI tests pass, including text fallback without Audio Tools, required-profile readiness failure, shortcut conflict reporting, explicit quit decisions, and source-pixel annotation mapping.

assertions: Text composition remains available while the voice control is visibly disabled when Audio Tools is absent.
A hung provider is bounded and cannot consume unbounded catalog worker capacity.
A local-control profile lacking Device Control is not marked ready.
Unavailable native shortcut registration is reported while manual presentation remains usable.
Scaled and portrait annotations map back to original source pixels and preserve regions across compact views.
Quit decisions wait for task stop and expose cancel/background/stop-and-quit outcomes without losing the draft.
limitations: These focused tests do not prove all optional-provider routing, keyboard-only surface stop flows, display topology recovery, or live native focus restoration.
